text:
scale-bot: AUTOSCALER: rapid scale-up in ap-southeast1b picked mixed instance classes for gpu-pool-7 (spot preference), ~18 new nodes in 6m.
anya: customers reporting model timeouts and 503s on reranker — looks like sudden OOMs/evictions.
reza: checked kube events: `Evicted: pod has unbounded memory usage` across several pods, but reason sometimes `nodeOutOfResource: gpu-mem` in scheduler logs.
hao: strange — autoscaler should respect minGpuVram. what policy allowed smaller VRAM types?
beth: we recently flipped `prefer_spot=true` for pools under load to save cost. probably pulled cheaper instances with 16GB vs usual 48GB.
ops-bot: metric: gpu_memory_pressure > 0.8 for pool-7 for 7m. eviction_count spike 21 in 8m.
anya: can we cordon the new small-vram nodes and move pods back to healthy nodes?
reza: running: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-pool-7 -o json | jq '.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, vram: .metadata.labels.gpu_vram}'` shows mixed labels 16, 24, 48.
hao: quick mitigation: 1) scale down spot-weight to 0 for pool-7, 2) cordon nodes with vram<32, 3) schedule descheduler for binpack. I'll run the cordon.
reza: cordon cmd: `kubectl cordon gpu-7-spot-1` then `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data gpu-7-spot-1` (drain in waves).
anya: after cordon, eviction rate dropped but we saw some restarts as pods adapt to GPU counts (model shards need full VRAM).
hao: scheduler logs: `I0605 03:12:09 scheduler.go:501] Rejecting node gpu-7-spot-2: Insufficient GPU memory for Pod heavy-infer-123` — so scheduler prevented placement but kubelet later reclaimed and pods got evicted.
beth: cost tradeoff note: we saved ~18% by enabling spot preference but the incident cost in retries/egress likely higher. need postmortem numbers.
ops-bot: created incident INC-2026 and paged oncall.
anya: followups: 1) add autoscaler constraint `min_gpu_vram=32GB` per pool, 2) add warmpool label check to prevent hetero mixes in a single warmpool, 3) add alert for gpu_memory_pressure > 0.6 for >5m.
reza: adding scheduler predicate to prefer same-vram nodes for gang-scheduled pods. will prototype policy in staging.
hao: also propose we add placement probe that verifies `labels.gpu_vram` homogeneous across AZ warmpool groups before scale-up completes.
beth: add ticket: INFRA-5177 (compare cost vs retries). assign to infra-cost + eng-platform.
anya: running capacity simulator tomorrow to validate fragmentation with multiple instance shapes. include traffic replay for hosted-api.
ops-bot: status: reduced spot weight, cordoned 9 nodes, eviction rate trending to 0.2/min.
anya: thanks — keep me posted. will draft Slack postmortem and a short blameless RCA template. :eyes:
